paragraphs: Rav Manyumi bar Chiyya. His son Abba: end of Yevamot.[^1][^2]

notes.text: אבא בריה explicitly calls Abba his son, as Hyman presents it. The locator is only “end of Yevamot,” without a folio. The supplied patronymic is חייא; earlier machine OCR had ח׳א. Rav is written in full.
This renders Hyman’s supplied citation; its occurrence and edition-specific locator have not been independently checked.
